servicios_plazo_unico_o_doble.name: servicios_plazo_unico_o_doble
servicios_plazo_unico_o_doble.value:
("servicios"."plazo_dias" is not null and "servicios"."plazo_interno_dias" is null and "servicios"."plazo_comercial_dias" is null)
          or
          ("servicios"."plazo_dias" is null and "servicios"."plazo_interno_dias" is not null and "servicios"."plazo_comercial_dias" is not null)

project_assignments_activa_work_item_uni.name: project_assignments_activa_work_item_unique
project_assignments_activa_work_item_uni.where: "project_assignments"."work_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "project_assignments"."finalizado_en" IS NULL

decisiones_origen_tipo_check.name: decisiones_origen_tipo_check
decisiones_origen_tipo_check.value: ("decisiones"."tipo"='revision_previa_correccion' AND "decisiones"."origin_correccion_id" IS NOT NULL AND "decisiones"."origin_calidad_fase_id" IS NULL) OR ("decisiones"."tipo"='coleccion_inconsistente' AND "decisiones"."origin_calidad_fase_id" IS NOT NULL AND "decisiones"."origin_correccion_id" IS NULL)

decisiones_resolucion_check.name: decisiones_resolucion_check
decisiones_resolucion_check.value: ("decisiones"."status"='resuelta' AND "decisiones"."resolution_type" IN ('approved','rejected','cancelled') AND "decisiones"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "decisiones"."resolved_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("decisiones"."status"<>'resuelta' AND "decisiones"."resolution_type" IS NULL AND "decisiones"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "decisiones"."resolved_by_user_id" IS NULL)

solicitudes_area_conversion_valid.name: solicitudes_area_conversion_valid
solicitudes_area_conversion_valid.value: ("solicitudes_area"."tipo"='creativa' or ("solicitudes_area"."work_item_id" is not null and "solicitudes_area"."requested_by_id" is not null)) and ("solicitudes_area"."tipo"<>'creativa' or "solicitudes_area"."estado"<>'resuelta' or "solicitudes_area"."work_item_id" is not null)

monthly_goals_valid_type.name: monthly_goals_valid_type
monthly_goals_valid_type.value: ("monthly_goals"."goal_type"='GENERAL' and "monthly_goals"."target_process" is null and "monthly_goals"."target_work_item_id" is null) or ("monthly_goals"."project_id" is not null and (("monthly_goals"."goal_type"='CIERRE_PROYECTO' and "monthly_goals"."target_process" is null and "monthly_goals"."target_work_item_id" is null) or ("monthly_goals"."goal_type"='ALCANZAR_PROCESO' and "monthly_goals"."target_process" is not null and "monthly_goals"."target_work_item_id" is null) or ("monthly_goals"."goal_type"='ALCANZAR_HITO' and "monthly_goals"."target_work_item_id" is not null and "monthly_goals"."target_process" is null)))

monthly_goals_valid_completion.name: monthly_goals_valid_completion
monthly_goals_valid_completion.value: "monthly_goals"."status"<>'CUMPLIDO' or ("monthly_goals"."completed_at" is not null and "monthly_goals"."evidence" is not null)

project_drive_workspace_ready_valid.name: project_drive_workspace_ready_valid
project_drive_workspace_ready_valid.value: "project_drive_workspaces"."status"<>'READY' or ("project_drive_workspaces"."root_folder_id" is not null and "project_drive_workspaces"."root_folder_url" is not null and "project_drive_workspaces"."ready_at" is not null)
